m: वर्ज mf(आ)n. (ifc.) free from, devoid of, excluding, with the exception of MBh.; BhP.
वर्ज m. leaving, leaving out, excepting, W.
वर्ज &c. See col. 1.
वर्ज &c. See p. 924, col. 1.
a: वर्जं — ind. To the exclusion of, excluding, except (at the end of comp.); गौतमीवर्जमितरा निष्क्रांताः Ś. 4; Ku. 7. 72.

m: वर्˚जक mfn. (ifc.) shunning, avoiding, MBh.; Hcat.
excluding, exclusive of MW.
a: वर्जक — a. (At the end of comp.) 1 Exclusive of, excluding. --2 Leaving, avoiding, abandoning.

m: वर्जम् ind. (अम्) See below.
वर्˚जम् ind. (mostly ifc., exceptionally with acc.) excluding, excepting, except, without, with the exception of GṛŚrS.; Mn. &c.
वर्˚जनीय mfn. to be excluded or shunned or avoided, improper, censurable, Mn.; MBh. &c.

v: na॰ vfja lyuw । 1 tyAge 2 hiMsAyAM ca 3 mAraRe medi॰
m: वर्˚जन n. excluding, avoiding, leaving, abandoning, Mn.; MBh. &c.
neglect, Pañcar.
omission, ĀśvŚr.
exception, Pāṇ. i, 4, 88 &c.
hurting, injury, L.
a: वर्जनं — [वृज्-ल्युट्] 1 Leaving, giving up, abandoning. --2 Renouncing. --3 Exception, exclusion. --4 Hurt, injury, killing.

m: वर्˚जयितव्य mfn. to be shunned or avoided, VarBṛS.
वर्˚जयितृ mfn. one who excludes or avoids or shuns, MBh.
one who pours out, discharger (of rain), Sāy.
वर्˚जिन् mfn. avoiding, shunning, MBh.
वर्जित mfn. excluded, abandoned, avoided, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(with instr. or ifc.) deprived of, wanting, without, with the exception of Mn.; MBh. &c.
वर्जित &c. See p. 924, col. 1.
a: वर्जित — p. p. 1 Left out, excepted. --2 Abandoned, relinquished. --3 Excluded. --4 Deprived of, destitute of, without; as in गुणवर्जित.

s: tri, (vfj + anIyar .) varjjanayogyam । tyaktavyam । varjjanIyAnnaM yaTA, -- “rAjAnnaM narttakAnnaYca takzRo'nnaYcakrakAriRaH । gaRAnna gaRikAnnaYca zaRqAnnaYcEva varjjayet ॥ cakropajIvirajakataskaraDvajinAntaTA । gAnDarvvalohakArAnnaM sUtakAnnaM vivarjjayet ॥ kulAlacitrakarmmAnnaM vArdDuzeH patitasya ca । pOnarBavacCAtrikayoraBiSastasya cEva hi ॥ suvarRakAraSElUzavyADitasyAturasya ca । cikitsakasya cEvAnnaM puMScalyA dARqikasya ca ॥ stenanAstikayorannaM devatAninda kasya ca । somavikrayiRaScAnnaM SvapAkasya viSezataH ॥ BAryyAjitasya cEvAnnaM yasya copapatirgfhe । utsfzwasya kadaryyasya taTEvocCizwaBojinaH ॥ apANktAnnaYca saMGAnnaM SastrAjIvasya cEva hi । klIvasyAntyAsinaScAnnaM mattonmattasya cEva hi ॥ BItasya ruditasyAnnamavakruzwaM parikzitam । brahmadbizaH pAparuceH SrAdDAnnaM mftakasya ca ॥ vfTApAkasya cEvAnnaM SAvAnnaM SvaSurasya ca । aprajAnAntu nArIRAM kftaGnasya taTEva hi ॥ kandukAnnaM viSezeRa SastravikrayiRastaTA । SORqAnnaM GawakAnnaYca BizajAmannameva ca ॥ vidDaprajananasyAnnaM parivittyannameva ca । punarBuvo viSezeRa taTEva diDizUpateH ॥ avajYAtaYcAvaDftaM sarozaM vismayAnvitam । gurorapi na BoktavyaM annaM satkAravarjjitam ॥ duzkftaM hi manuzyasya sarvvamannezvanuzWitam । yo yasyAnnaM samaSnAti sa tasyASnAti kilvizam ॥” iti SrIkUrmmapurARe upaviBAge 16 aDyAyaH ॥

tri, tyaktaH । vfjaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH । yaTA, -- “avajYAtaYcAvaDftaM sarozaM vismayAnvitam । gurorapi na BoktavyamannaM satkAravarjjitam ॥” iti kOrmme upavimAge 16 aDyAyaH ॥

tri, (vfj + Ryat .) varjjanIyaH । yaTA, -- “ataH praraM SfRuzva tvaM varjyAvarjyapratikriyAm । BojyamannaM paryyuzitaM snehAktaM cirasaMsTitam ॥ asnehAScApi goDUmayavagorasavikriyAH । SaSakaH kacCapo goDA seDA matsyo'Ta SallakaH ॥ BakzyA hyete sadA varjjyO grAmaSUkarakukkuwO । pitfdevAdiSezaYca SrAdDe brAhmaRakAmyayA । prokzitaYcOzaDArTaYca KAdan mAMsaMna dozaBAk ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe sadAcArADyAyaH ॥

m: वर्˚ज्य mfn. to be excluded or shunned or avoided or given up, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) with the exception of, exclusive of, without, MBh.; MārkP.
वर्˚ज्य n. a stage in each lunar mansion during which no business should be begun, W.
a: वर्ज्य — a. 1 To be avoided or shunned. --2 To be excluded or left out. --3 With the exception of. --र्ज्यं A point in each lunar mansion during which no business should be undertaken.
